name: GDC Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: GDC Team

sections.description:
GDC Crypto Payments for WooCommerce brings modern cryptocurrency payments to WooCommerce stores through direct wallet settlement and BTCPay integration.

The plugin supports two flexible modes:

  • Self-hosted BTCPay mode for merchants who want full control
  • CartPay Hosted Mode for faster onboarding and simplified setup

Designed for WooCommerce merchants who want direct-to-wallet crypto payments without complicated custodial systems.

Features

  • Direct-to-wallet crypto payments
  • WooCommerce payment gateway integration
  • Self-hosted BTCPay support
  • Optional hosted payment mode
  • Automatic order status updates
  • Live payment detection
  • Branded crypto checkout page
  • Webhook automation support
  • Merchant-controlled settlement
  • Lightweight WooCommerce integration
  • Secure API communication
  • Modern admin dashboard

Self-Hosted BTCPay Mode

Use your own BTCPay Server and maintain complete control over your payment infrastructure.

Ideal for merchants who:

  • Already use BTCPay
  • Want full infrastructure ownership
  • Prefer self-hosted payment systems

CartPay Hosted Mode

Hosted Mode simplifies onboarding and setup for merchants who want a faster deployment experience.

Hosted Mode includes:

  • Guided setup
  • Managed payment infrastructure
  • Faster onboarding
  • Simplified configuration
  • Direct Merchant Wallet Settlement

Why CartPay?

Unlike many traditional crypto payment systems, CartPay focuses on direct merchant wallet settlement and flexible deployment.

Merchants maintain control over their WooCommerce store, wallet, and payment flow.

External Services

GDC Crypto Payments for WooCommerce may communicate with external services when using CartPay Hosted Mode or license validation features.

These services may include:

  • Payment infrastructure APIs
  • License validation endpoints
  • Hosted checkout services

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gdc-crypto-payments-woocommerce directory, or install through WordPress Plugins.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  4. Enable CartPay.
  5. Configure either:
    • Self-hosted BTCPay mode
    • CartPay Hosted Mode
  6. Save settings.
  7. Start accepting crypto payments.
sections.faq:
Does CartPay hold merchant funds?

No. CartPay is designed around direct merchant settlement.

Do I need my own BTCPay Server?

No. You can use either:

  • Self-hosted BTCPay
  • CartPay Hosted Mode

Can I use my own wallet?

Yes. Merchants control their own wallet setup and payment destination.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is built specifically for WooCommerce.

Is CartPay custodial?

No. The system is designed around merchant-controlled settlement.

Can I use self-hosted BTCPay?

Yes. Self-hosted BTCPay integration is fully supported.

Does the plugin automatically update WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Orders can automatically update after successful payment confirmation.
